# Scribe 0.4.4
- Adds Apple Speech as an on-device live transcription option for Teacher Assistant while keeping completed-lesson transcription unchanged. - Adds optional experimental speaker echo reduction to saved recording setups and strengthens microphone recovery when audio devices change during a lesson. - Stops transcript audio as soon as you leave Transcriptions, remembers each lesson's position in memory, and prevents multiple lessons from playing at once. - Fixes Edited and Unedited filtering, queue pausing, safe transcript export, import cancellation, prepared lesson-focus invalidation, paired-device removal, and duplicate speaker-identity submissions. - Improves transcription ETA reporting and cold-start benchmarking, blocks recording until local transcription is ready, and gives interrupted recordings clearer keep-or-delete recovery choices. - Refreshes the installer disk image with a verified drag-to-Applications layout and stronger release auditing.

# Scribe 0.4.3
- Makes **Full lesson** a one-click recording path that captures the microphone and all audio the Mac actually plays, without choosing an application first. - Records the microphone independently while lesson audio is silent or a student is late, then preserves the real lesson-time offset when that audio begins. - Finalizes and transcribes every readable source that exists—teacher only, lesson audio only, or both—and reserves Recovery for captures with no readable audio. - Repairs partial recordings on Retry and skips empty placeholder tracks instead of reporting a transcription failure.

# Scribe 0.4.2
- Restores the update tile's original left-aligned layout. - Keeps secure in-app update checks and installation unchanged.

# Scribe 0.4.1
This hotfix restores startup after installing Scribe 0.4.0.
- Places the transcription resources where the packaged app can load them. - Adds a release audit that rejects a DMG when those resources are missing or misplaced.
If you installed 0.4.0 and Scribe quits immediately, download and install 0.4.1 once. In-app updates will work normally after that.

# Scribe 0.4.0
This is the bridge release that adds secure, native in-app updates.
- Adds Sparkle 2.9.6 for update checks, downloads, installation, and relaunching inside Scribe. - Publishes signed update artifacts separately from the private source repository. - Verifies every update with both Apple Developer ID and a dedicated EdDSA update signature. - Checks for updates automatically each day, with an optional automatic-download setting. - Keeps **Check for Updates…** in both Settings and the Scribe application menu.
After installing this bridge release manually, future releases can be installed without opening a browser or mounting a DMG.
